about: NHTSA vPIC (Product Information Catalog and Vehicle Listing): decode VINs and WMIs, look up makes, models and manufacturers through the public vPIC REST API, browse Canadian Vehicle Specifications, list approved replica manufacturers, and view MID manufacturer and vehicle-modifier detail pages.

commands.summary: Decode a full or partial VIN (use * as a wildcard) into a flat record with make, model, year, body, engine, safety equipment, plant and more

params.name: vin
params.description: 17-character VIN or partial VIN; use * for unknown positions, e.g. 5UXWX7C5*BA

params.name: modelyear
params.description: Model year. Recommended for partial VINs; when set it overrides the year decoded from the VIN

commands.summary: Decode a World Manufacturer Identifier (the first 3 or 6 VIN characters) into its manufacturer, make and vehicle type
List the models a make offers in a given model year
List all models for a make, identified by its numeric vPIC Make_ID

params.name: makeId
params.description: vPIC Make_ID, e.g. 474 for HONDA (from list-all-makes or list-models-for-make-year)

commands.summary: List every make in vPIC with its Make_ID (a large list, roughly 10k entries)
Look up manufacturers by full or partial name (or numeric manufacturer ID) and get address, country and vehicle types

params.name: manufacturer
params.description: Manufacturer name (partial match) or numeric Mfr_ID, e.g. tesla or 955

commands.summary: List the WMI codes assigned to a manufacturer, matched by full or partial name or ID

params.name: manufacturer
params.description: Manufacturer name (partial match) or ID, e.g. hon

commands.summary: List the makes that have Canadian Vehicle Specifications data for a model year
List the Canadian Vehicle Specifications model names for a year, optionally limited to one make

params.name: make
params.description: Make name in upper case as returned by list-canadian-spec-makes, e.g. FORD; empty for all makes

commands.summary: Get Canadian Vehicle Specifications dimensions (length, width, height, wheelbase, curb weight, track, weight distribution) for a year and make, optionally one model

params.name: make
params.description: Make in upper case, e.g. HONDA

params.name: model
params.description: Exact model name from list-canadian-spec-models, e.g. ACCORD 2DR COUPE LX-G/EX-L; empty for all models of the make

commands.summary: List NHTSA-approved low-volume replica vehicle manufacturers with their approved vehicles and status, paginated and searchable

params.name: search
params.description: Keyword filter applied across all columns

commands.summary: Get a manufacturer's MID profile by manufacturer ID: contacts, address, makes and models, WMIs, manufacturer types and Part 565/566 filings

params.name: id
params.description: Manufacturer ID (Mfr_ID), e.g. 955 for Tesla or 988 for American Honda

commands.summary: Get a registered adapted-vehicle modifier's details (DBAs, address, phone, contact) by modifier ID
